overviewHtml:
This graded quiz assesses your understanding of AI's effects on work and education and of who controls the resources AI depends on. You'll be asked about exposure and displacement, productivity evidence, the entry-level employment finding, survey evidence, performance and learning, the three positions on AI in education, the AI supply chain, energy use, market power, and export controls.

Note: Aim for a score of 80 percent or higher. If you score lower, use the feedback to review the topics you missed, then retake the quiz.

forms.stemHtml: A study estimates that about 19 percent of US workers are in jobs where at least half of the tasks are exposed to AI. What does this tell you about those workers?

options.html: They will lose their jobs within the next five years
options.text: They will lose their jobs within the next five years
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on tasks versus jobs.

options.html: Their employers have replaced half of their tasks with AI
options.text: Their employers have replaced half of their tasks with AI
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on tasks versus jobs.

options.html: AI could do or speed up at least half of their tasks
options.text: AI could do or speed up at least half of their tasks
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Exposure describes what is technically possible. It doesn't say what employers have done or will do, or when.

options.html: Their pay has fallen by half since AI tools appeared
options.text: Their pay has fallen by half since AI tools appeared
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on tasks versus jobs.

forms.stemHtml: An experiment finds that AI makes customer support agents 14 percent more productive. An economist estimates that AI will add less than 1 percent to the whole economy's productivity over ten years. What best explains the difference?

options.html: The experiment was badly designed and its result is unreliable
options.text: The experiment was badly designed and its result is unreliable
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on productivity evidence.

options.html: The gain applies to a small share of the economy's tasks
options.text: The gain applies to a small share of the economy's tasks
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! An economy-wide estimate multiplies the gain on each affected task by the share of tasks affected. A large gain on a small share is small overall.

options.html: The economist assumed that AI tools will stop improving
options.text: The economist assumed that AI tools will stop improving
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on productivity evidence.

options.html: Customer support is not counted as part of the economy
options.text: Customer support is not counted as part of the economy
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on productivity evidence.

forms.stemHtml: A study of payroll records found that employment of workers aged 22 to 25 in AI-exposed occupations stood 19 percent below where it would be had it kept pace with less-exposed peers. Which statements about this finding are accurate? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: The authors describe it as descriptive and not as a causal estimate
options.text: The authors describe it as descriptive and not as a causal estimate
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! They call their results early, descriptive indicators.

options.html: It shows that AI has caused 19 percent of young workers to be laid off
options.text: It shows that AI has caused 19 percent of young workers to be laid off
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on entry-level work.

options.html: The gap comes mainly from reduced hiring
options.text: The gap comes mainly from reduced hiring
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The study reports fewer young workers being hired, not more being dismissed.

options.html: Experienced workers show no comparable gap
options.text: Experienced workers show no comparable gap
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The pattern is specific to workers at the start of their careers.

forms.stemHtml: A survey finds that 95 percent of undergraduates report using AI in at least one way. What can you conclude from this result?

options.html: AI has improved the learning of nearly all undergraduates
options.text: AI has improved the learning of nearly all undergraduates
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on student and teacher use of AI.

options.html: Nearly all undergraduates submit work written by AI
options.text: Nearly all undergraduates submit work written by AI
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on student and teacher use of AI.

options.html: Nearly all of the students surveyed say they use AI
options.text: Nearly all of the students surveyed say they use AI
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! A survey shows what people report about their behavior. It doesn't measure what they learned.

options.html: Universities have approved AI use for nearly all courses
options.text: Universities have approved AI use for nearly all courses
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on student and teacher use of AI.

forms.stemHtml: A student uses a chatbot to complete every problem in a homework set and gets full marks. A week later, in an exam with no chatbot, the student can't solve similar problems. Which statement describes this?

options.html: Low performance and low learning
options.text: Low performance and low learning
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on performance versus learning.

options.html: High performance and low learning
options.text: High performance and low learning
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Performance is how well a student does with whatever help is available. Learning is what the student can do without help afterward.

options.html: Low performance and high learning
options.text: Low performance and high learning
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on performance versus learning.

options.html: High performance and high learning
options.text: High performance and high learning
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on performance versus learning.

forms.stemHtml: A school board member says, "If a chatbot can write the essay, the essay is no longer telling us what the student knows. We need different assignments." Which position on AI in education is this?

options.html: Tutor for every student
options.text: Tutor for every student
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the three positions on AI in education.

options.html: Threat to learning
options.text: Threat to learning
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the three positions on AI in education.

options.html: Assessment reform
options.text: Assessment reform
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! This position holds that a task AI can complete no longer measures learning, so the task should change.

options.html: Human-centered approach
options.text: Human-centered approach
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the three positions on AI in education.

forms.stemHtml: A US regulator examined three partnerships between cloud providers and AI model developers. What did the cloud providers typically receive?

options.html: Full ownership of the developer and of every model it has built
options.text: Full ownership of the developer and of every model it has built
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the AI supply chain.

options.html: A government license to operate data centers
options.text: A government license to operate data centers
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the AI supply chain.

options.html: The right to set prices for all AI products
options.text: The right to set prices for all AI products
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the AI supply chain.

options.html: An ownership stake and a commitment to buy their cloud services
options.text: An ownership stake and a commitment to buy their cloud services
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The partnerships gave cloud providers equity, revenue-sharing rights, and commitments by the developer to spend much of the investment on the partner's cloud.

forms.stemHtml: Which statements about data center electricity use are accurate? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: Data centers used an estimated 1.5 percent of the world's electricity in 2024
options.text: Data centers used an estimated 1.5 percent of the world's electricity in 2024
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The International Energy Agency put the figure at about 415 terawatt-hours.

options.html: The figure for 2030 is a projection, not a measurement
options.text: The figure for 2030 is a projection, not a measurement
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! It is calculated from assumptions about growth, and other scenarios give different totals.

options.html: Data center demand is spread evenly across the world's countries
options.text: Data center demand is spread evenly across the world's countries
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on energy and water use.

options.html: Local effects can be much larger than the global share suggests
options.text: Local effects can be much larger than the global share suggests
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! One AI-focused data center can use as much electricity as 100,000 households.

forms.stemHtml: The UK's competition authority wrote that partnerships involving key players "could reinforce or extend existing positions of market power." What is the status of this statement?

options.html: A finding that the partnerships broke competition law
options.text: A finding that the partnerships broke competition law
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on concentration of market power.

options.html: A stated risk, with no finding that harm has occurred
options.text: A stated risk, with no finding that harm has occurred
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! "Could" marks a possibility. The authority documented the partnerships and warned of what might follow.

options.html: A ruling that the partnerships must be ended
options.text: A ruling that the partnerships must be ended
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on concentration of market power.

options.html: A conclusion that the partnerships are harmless
options.text: A conclusion that the partnerships are harmless
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on concentration of market power.

forms.stemHtml: Which statements about United States policy on exporting advanced AI chips are accurate? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: The United States has restricted exports of advanced chips to China since 2022
options.text: The United States has restricted exports of advanced chips to China since 2022
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The policy has been revised several times since.

options.html: A rule sorting countries into tiers was issued in January 2025 and rescinded that May
options.text: A rule sorting countries into tiers was issued in January 2025 and rescinded that May
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The rule was withdrawn before its requirements took effect.

options.html: In January 2026 the policy changed to allow some chips to be sold to China after case-by-case review
options.text: In January 2026 the policy changed to allow some chips to be sold to China after case-by-case review
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Sales are permitted under stated conditions.

options.html: The policy has stayed the same since it was first introduced
options.text: The policy has stayed the same since it was first introduced
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on export controls on advanced chips.

forms.stemHtml: What does an exposure study measure?

options.html: Which tasks AI could do or speed up, as researchers judge
options.text: Which tasks AI could do or speed up, as researchers judge
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Researchers go through the tasks in each occupation and judge whether AI could affect them. The result describes potential.

options.html: How many workers have been laid off because of AI so far
options.text: How many workers have been laid off because of AI so far
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on tasks versus jobs.

options.html: How quickly employers in each industry are adopting AI tools
options.text: How quickly employers in each industry are adopting AI tools
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on tasks versus jobs.

options.html: Which occupations will no longer exist ten years from now
options.text: Which occupations will no longer exist ten years from now
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on tasks versus jobs.

forms.stemHtml: An economy-wide estimate of AI's effect on productivity is built from two inputs. One is the average saving on each affected task. What is the other?

options.html: The number of AI companies operating in the economy
options.text: The number of AI companies operating in the economy
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on productivity evidence.

options.html: The price that employers pay for AI tools each year
options.text: The price that employers pay for AI tools each year
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on productivity evidence.

options.html: The number of workers who say they trust AI tools
options.text: The number of workers who say they trust AI tools
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on productivity evidence.

options.html: The share of the economy's tasks that AI affects
options.text: The share of the economy's tasks that AI affects
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The estimate multiplies the share of tasks affected by the saving on each. A small share keeps the total small even when the saving per task is large.

forms.stemHtml: Critics of the payroll study on young workers offered a different explanation for the employment gap. Which statements about the critique are accurate? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: It attributes the pattern to rising interest rates
options.text: It attributes the pattern to rising interest rates
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The critics argue the pattern reflects the sharpest tightening of monetary policy in four decades.

options.html: It notes that job postings in exposed occupations peaked before the first widely used chatbot was released
options.text: It notes that job postings in exposed occupations peaked before the first widely used chatbot was released
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Postings peaked in March and April 2022, and the chatbot was released that November.

options.html: Its authors are economists at a company that develops AI
options.text: Its authors are economists at a company that develops AI
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Their employer benefits if AI isn't blamed for job losses, which is a reason to weigh the critique with care.

options.html: It denies that employment of young workers fell behind at all
options.text: It denies that employment of young workers fell behind at all
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on entry-level work.

forms.stemHtml: In a survey, 12 percent of students say they include AI-generated text directly in graded work. Why is this figure better read as a minimum than as an exact count?

options.html: The survey asked too few students for any figure to be useful
options.text: The survey asked too few students for any figure to be useful
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on student and teacher use of AI.

options.html: Surveys always double-count the students who answer them
options.text: Surveys always double-count the students who answer them
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on student and teacher use of AI.

options.html: The figure was calculated from software that detects AI text
options.text: The figure was calculated from software that detects AI text
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on student and teacher use of AI.

options.html: It rests on self-report, and students have a reason to say no
options.text: It rests on self-report, and students have a reason to say no
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Self-report is what people say about their own behavior, which can differ from what they do. A student may not admit to something that could count as misconduct.

forms.stemHtml: In a field experiment in high school mathematics, students who practiced with an ordinary chatbot scored 48 percent higher in practice than students with no AI. On a later exam without AI they scored 17 percent lower. What does the exam result measure?

options.html: Their performance with help
options.text: Their performance with help
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on performance versus learning.

options.html: Their attitude toward AI
options.text: Their attitude toward AI
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on performance versus learning.

options.html: Their skill at using chatbots
options.text: Their skill at using chatbots
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on performance versus learning.

options.html: Their learning without help
options.text: Their learning without help
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! An unassisted exam shows what students retained. The chatbot raised performance during practice and lowered learning.

forms.stemHtml: A teacher says, "One-to-one teaching has always worked best and most students never get it. A well-designed AI system could give it to all of them." Which position on AI in education is this?

options.html: Tutor for every student
options.text: Tutor for every student
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! This position holds that well-designed AI can teach each student individually, and it depends on tools built for teaching.

options.html: Threat to learning
options.text: Threat to learning
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the three positions on AI in education.

options.html: Assessment reform
options.text: Assessment reform
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the three positions on AI in education.

options.html: Human-centered approach
options.text: Human-centered approach
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the three positions on AI in education.

forms.stemHtml: In a typical partnership between a cloud provider and an AI model developer, what does the developer mainly get?

options.html: Money and computing power it couldn't otherwise buy
options.text: Money and computing power it couldn't otherwise buy
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Training and running large models takes scarce and costly computing power, which cloud providers own.

options.html: Protection from any future review by competition regulators
options.text: Protection from any future review by competition regulators
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the AI supply chain.

options.html: Ownership of the cloud provider's data centers
options.text: Ownership of the cloud provider's data centers
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the AI supply chain.

options.html: The exclusive right to design specialized chips
options.text: The exclusive right to design specialized chips
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the AI supply chain.

forms.stemHtml: A company spokesperson says data centers are "a tiny fraction of global electricity use." A resident says the data center proposed for her county "will use as much power as a city." Which statements about these two claims are accurate? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: Both can be supported by published figures
options.text: Both can be supported by published figures
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The global share is small, and a single large site can match the use of 100,000 households or more.

options.html: They differ in the unit they treat as relevant: the world or the locality
options.text: They differ in the unit they treat as relevant: the world or the locality
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Neither misstates the numbers. They frame the same figures differently.

options.html: Each speaker benefits from the framing they chose
options.text: Each speaker benefits from the framing they chose
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Companies building data centers gain from the global framing, and opponents of a site gain from the local one.

options.html: The spokesperson's claim is false, because data centers use most of the world's electricity
options.text: The spokesperson's claim is false, because data centers use most of the world's electricity
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on energy and water use.

forms.stemHtml: A headline reads, "Regulators find AI giants are crushing competition." The regulators' reports documented many partnerships and described ways they might harm competition. What is wrong with the headline?

options.html: The regulators did not look at partnerships at all
options.text: The regulators did not look at partnerships at all
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on concentration of market power.

options.html: The regulators found that competition was strong
options.text: The regulators found that competition was strong
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on concentration of market power.

options.html: The regulators have no interest in AI companies
options.text: The regulators have no interest in AI companies
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on concentration of market power.

options.html: It reports a stated risk as a finding of harm
options.text: It reports a stated risk as a finding of harm
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The partnerships and their terms are established. Harm to competition is a risk the regulators described, and neither report claims to have found it.

forms.stemHtml: Under the US policy announced in January 2026, some advanced chips can be exported to China after case-by-case review. Which statements about this policy and its history are accurate? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: It followed an earlier period of tighter restriction
options.text: It followed an earlier period of tighter restriction
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Restrictions began in 2022, and controls aimed at China were tightened in May 2025.

options.html: It removed all conditions on the sale of chips to China
options.text: It removed all conditions on the sale of chips to China
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on export controls on advanced chips.

options.html: Exporters must show the sale won't reduce the supply available to US customers
options.text: Exporters must show the sale won't reduce the supply available to US customers
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! This is one of the stated conditions, along with buyer compliance procedures and independent testing.

options.html: It is the policy in force on a given date and may change again
options.text: It is the policy in force on a given date and may change again
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The policy has shifted repeatedly, in both directions.

forms.stemHtml: An occupation is rated as highly exposed to AI. What does the rating say about whether its tasks will be automated or augmented?

options.html: The tasks will be automated, because exposure means replacement
options.text: The tasks will be automated, because exposure means replacement
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on tasks versus jobs.

options.html: The tasks will be augmented, because exposure means assistance
options.text: The tasks will be augmented, because exposure means assistance
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on tasks versus jobs.

options.html: The tasks will be unchanged, because exposure is only a theory
options.text: The tasks will be unchanged, because exposure is only a theory
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on tasks versus jobs.

options.html: Nothing; either could follow, depending on employers' choices
options.text: Nothing; either could follow, depending on employers' choices
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! An exposed task can be automated, augmented, or rearranged. The exposure score doesn't say which.

forms.stemHtml: Two forecasters accept the same task-level experiments and still disagree about AI's effect on the whole economy. What do they most likely disagree about?

options.html: How many tasks AI will reach, and how quickly
options.text: How many tasks AI will reach, and how quickly
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Both sides accept the measured gains on particular tasks. The economy-wide figure depends on the share of tasks affected and the pace of adoption, which haven't been observed.

options.html: Whether the task-level experiments were run honestly
options.text: Whether the task-level experiments were run honestly
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on productivity evidence.

options.html: Whether productivity can be measured in any way at all
options.text: Whether productivity can be measured in any way at all
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on productivity evidence.

options.html: Whether customer support and software count as real work
options.text: Whether customer support and software count as real work
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on productivity evidence.

forms.stemHtml: A news story reports the payroll study on young workers under the headline "AI has destroyed 19 percent of entry-level jobs." Which statements about this headline are accurate? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: It turns a gap relative to a comparison group into a count of lost jobs
options.text: It turns a gap relative to a comparison group into a count of lost jobs
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The 19 percent is the distance between two groups, not a number of jobs that disappeared.

options.html: It names a cause that the study's authors decline to name
options.text: It names a cause that the study's authors decline to name
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The authors present descriptive indicators and not causal estimates.

options.html: It matches what the study's authors say they found
options.text: It matches what the study's authors say they found
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on entry-level work.

options.html: It leaves out that economists dispute the cause
options.text: It leaves out that economists dispute the cause
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! A published critique attributes the pattern to interest rates.

forms.stemHtml: Almost half of the students in a survey say AI has improved their experience as students. What would you need in order to know whether AI helped them learn?

options.html: A test of what the students can do without AI
options.text: A test of what the students can do without AI
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Surveys record opinions and reported behavior. Learning has to be measured by testing what students know or can do.

options.html: A larger survey that asks the same question again
options.text: A larger survey that asks the same question again
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on student and teacher use of AI.

options.html: A count of how many hours they spent using AI
options.text: A count of how many hours they spent using AI
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on student and teacher use of AI.

options.html: A statement from their university about its AI policy
options.text: A statement from their university about its AI policy
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on student and teacher use of AI.

forms.stemHtml: What is the difference between performance and learning?

options.html: Performance is measured by teachers, and learning is measured by students
options.text: Performance is measured by teachers, and learning is measured by students
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on performance versus learning.

options.html: Performance concerns mathematics, and learning concerns writing
options.text: Performance concerns mathematics, and learning concerns writing
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on performance versus learning.

options.html: Performance is doing a task with help; learning is what lasts without it
options.text: Performance is doing a task with help; learning is what lasts without it
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! AI can raise the first without raising the second, because the tool may do the part of the task that produces learning.

options.html: Performance is a long-term change, and learning is a score on one task
options.text: Performance is a long-term change, and learning is a score on one task
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on performance versus learning.

forms.stemHtml: A parent says, "In practice students just ask for the answer. They hand in good work and haven't done the thinking it was supposed to make them do." Which position on AI in education is this?

options.html: Tutor for every student
options.text: Tutor for every student
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the three positions on AI in education.

options.html: Assessment reform
options.text: Assessment reform
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the three positions on AI in education.

options.html: Human-centered approach
options.text: Human-centered approach
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the three positions on AI in education.

options.html: Threat to learning
options.text: Threat to learning
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! This position holds that ordinary use of AI replaces the student's own thinking, and it depends on how students use tools when unguided.

forms.stemHtml: A cloud provider invests several billion dollars in an AI model developer. Under the agreement, the developer must spend much of that money on the provider's own cloud services. What does this arrangement show about such partnerships?

options.html: Developers give up nothing in return for investment
options.text: Developers give up nothing in return for investment
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the AI supply chain.

options.html: Cloud providers make these investments as donations
options.text: Cloud providers make these investments as donations
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the AI supply chain.

options.html: They trade investment and computing for stakes and spending
options.text: They trade investment and computing for stakes and spending
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The cloud provider supplies money and computing power, and gets an ownership stake and a committed customer in return. Part of the money travels in a circle.

options.html: Regulators have ruled that agreements of this kind are illegal
options.text: Regulators have ruled that agreements of this kind are illegal
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the AI supply chain.

forms.stemHtml: Which of these figures about data centers are estimates of the present, as opposed to projections of the future? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: About 415 terawatt-hours of electricity consumed in 2024
options.text: About 415 terawatt-hours of electricity consumed in 2024
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! This is an estimate of consumption that has already happened, built from incomplete data.

options.html: Around 945 terawatt-hours of electricity consumed in 2030
options.text: Around 945 terawatt-hours of electricity consumed in 2030
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on energy and water use.

options.html: The United States accounting for 45 percent of the 2024 total
options.text: The United States accounting for 45 percent of the 2024 total
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! This describes where consumption took place in 2024.

options.html: Data centers accounting for nearly half of US demand growth to 2030
options.text: Data centers accounting for nearly half of US demand growth to 2030
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on energy and water use.

forms.stemHtml: Regulators in the United Kingdom and the United States have studied partnerships between large technology firms and AI developers. Which of these is established by their reports?

options.html: The partnerships exist, with terms such as equity stakes
options.text: The partnerships exist, with terms such as equity stakes
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The existence and terms of the partnerships are documented. Whether they harm competition is disputed.

options.html: The partnerships have raised prices for consumers
options.text: The partnerships have raised prices for consumers
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on concentration of market power.

options.html: The partnerships have shut rivals out of the market
options.text: The partnerships have shut rivals out of the market
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on concentration of market power.

options.html: The partnerships violate competition law in both countries
options.text: The partnerships violate competition law in both countries
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on concentration of market power.

forms.stemHtml: United States policy on selling advanced AI chips to China has moved between restriction and controlled sales. Which statements about this history are accurate? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: Officials have justified both restriction and controlled sales as serving national security
options.text: Officials have justified both restriction and controlled sales as serving national security
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Restriction is said to slow a rival, and controlled sales are said to keep it dependent on US technology.

options.html: The policy has moved in both directions since 2022
options.text: The policy has moved in both directions since 2022
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Controls were tightened in 2025 and loosened for some chips in 2026.

options.html: Chips were chosen for control because they are the easiest input to copy
options.text: Chips were chosen for control because they are the easiest input to copy
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on export controls on advanced chips.

options.html: Chip makers gain directly when sales are permitted
options.text: Chip makers gain directly when sales are permitted
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! China is a large market, so their statements in favor of sales should be read with that interest in mind.

title: Work, Education, and Economic Power
